mapper.sql: id, name, bonus_stamps, days_mask, start_time, end_time, starts_on, ends_on, branch_id, active, notify_on_start, notified_at, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM bonus_rules ORDER BY active DESC, created_at DESC, id
SELECT FROM bonus_rules WHERE active AND (starts_on IS NULL OR starts_on <= #{day}) AND (ends_on IS NULL OR ends_on >= #{day}) ORDER BY bonus_stamps DESC, created_at, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bonus_rules (id, name, bonus_stamps, days_mask, start_time, end_time, starts_on, ends_on, branch_id, active, notify_on_start, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, CAST(#{name} AS jsonb), #{bonusStamps}, #{daysMask}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{startsOn}, #{endsOn}, #{branchId}, #{active}, #{notifyOnStart}, #{now}, #{staffId}, #{now}, #{staffId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM bonus_rules r WHERE r.id = #{id} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stamps s WHERE s.bonus_rule_id = r.id)
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM branches WHERE id = #{branchId})
mapper.update: UPDATE bonus_rules SET notified_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND notified_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT bonus_rule_id AS rule_id, count(*) AS bonus_stamps, count(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers FROM stamps WHERE source = 'BONUS' AND status = 'CONFIRMED' AND created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY bonus_rule_id
SELECT c.id FROM customers c WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM push_subscriptions p WHERE p.customer_id = c.id) ORDER BY c.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bonus_rule_deliveries (rule_id, customer_id, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{ruleId}, #{customerId}, 'PENDING', #{now}, #{now}) ON CONFLICT (rule_id, customer_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE bonus_rule_deliveries SET status = #{status}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE rule_id = #{ruleId} AND customer_id = #{customerId}
mapper.select: SELECT rule_id, count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'DELIVERED') AS delivered, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'FAILED') AS failed FROM bonus_rule_deliveries GROUP BY rule_id

SELECT d.customer_id, c.name, c.phone_masked, d.status, d.updated_at FROM bonus_rule_deliveries d JOIN customers c ON c.id = d.customer_id
ORDER BY c.name NULLS LAST, c.phone_masked, d.customer_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
